item.title: CFO, CHEd to strengthen education opportunities for Filipinos abroad

item.title: 5150 Guimaras ignites triathlon season, kicks off PH Islands Series

item.title: Quezon City fire affects 4,000 families
item.description: MANILA, Philippines — A massive fire that tore through a residential community along NIA Road in Pinyahan village, Quezon City destroyed 80 to 95 percent of houses in the area and affected about 4,000 families, barangay officials said Saturday.The fire was first raised to the first alarm at 9:01 p.m. on March 6, 2026 before escalating to the 5th alarm at 9:44 p.m., according to the Bureau of Fire Protection-National Capital Region (BFP-NCR). item.title: Russian flag returns as Milan Cortina Winter Paralympics open amid Iran war and boycott
item.description: VERONA, Italy — The Milan Cortina Winter Paralympics opened Friday amid the tensions of intensifying war in the Middle East and with some countries boycotting the opening ceremony because of the return of the Russian flag to the global sports stage.The Russian flag made its return during the nations' parade, marking the first time it was flown at the Paralympics since the 2014 Winter Games in Sochi, and signaling a possible full-fledged return to the Olympic circles ahead of the 2028 Summer Game
